common_species_sensitivity.interpretation: The same-layer North-Tropical joint vector difference persists when both primary axes are rebuilt from the same co-observed species denominator. Individual within-context component directions are not required to reproduce the frozen H2 point estimates under this changed estimand.

realm_boundary.rule: Do not substitute Palearctic-versus-tropical cross-layer wording for the formal same-layer North-Tropical contrast.

publication_claim: Within the frozen analysis-regime layer, northern-midlatitude and tropical floral/reproductive response vectors differ directly, and that joint difference persists under common-island and common-species denominator restrictions. The stronger claim that the two response vectors are demonstrably non-collinear is not supported by paired spatial-block uncertainty.
forbidden_claims: Palearctic and tropical are the two sides of one formal direct context contrast
the North-Tropical vectors are proven non-collinear
the common-species sensitivity preserves every original within-context component slope
